statement:
theorem core_fiber (x y b : K) :
    (rValue x y b = 0 ∧ tValue x y b = 1 / 8 ∧ sValue x y b = 0) ↔
    (x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ b =  -1 / 4) ∨
    (x = 1 ∧ y =  -3 / 2 ∧ b = 13 / 2) ∨
    (x =  -1 ∧ y = 3 / 2 ∧ b = 13 / 2)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.localized_core
statement:
theorem localized_core (x y b : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    let w := 1 + x * y
    let a := 2 - 3 * x * y - x ^ 2 * b
    rValue x y b = x * a ∧
    sValue x y b = (2 + 4 * w - 3 * a * w ^ 2) / x ∧
    tValue x y b = (a * w ^ 3 - w ^ 2 - w) / (2 * x ^ 2)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.firstOrder_commutator
statement:
theorem firstOrder_commutator (a b : Poly K) (i j : Var) :
    (polynomial K a * deriv K i) * (polynomial K b * deriv K j) -
      (polynomial K b * deriv K j) * (polynomial K a * deriv K i) =
      polynomial K (a*MvPolynomial.pderiv i b) * deriv K j -
      polynomial K (b*MvPolynomial.pderiv j a) * deriv K i

      polynomial K (a*b) * (deriv K i * deriv K j) +
      polynomial K (a*MvPolynomial.pderiv i b) * deriv K j
